name: @estebanforge/pi-ask-claude
description: Pi tool that delegates a self-contained sub-task to the Claude Code CLI via `claude -p --output-format stream-json`. Streams structured events as partial output, returns the final agent message. Configurable default model + effort + permission mode, with multi-turn session continuity via `--resume`. Self-disables when pi-claude-bridge is installed, enabled, and has its own AskClaude enabled, to avoid a duplicate-tool conflict.
